scope: Development proposal and interactive UI design only
verified_interactions: Customer binding requires identity confirmation and leaves automatic reception paused.
Binding closes the old AI suggestion; context drawer is visible and Escape closes it.
Simulated login success does not enable automatic reception.
Unbound customers cannot enable automatic reception; unknown sends block new sends.
Adopting a suggestion replaces the editor text, closes the suggestion and pauses this customer.
The 1100x820 layout keeps the editor within the viewport and exposes context through a drawer.

earlier_driver_attempts.resolution: Used an explicit Electron executable and removed inherited runtime and credential environment variables.
Read the trailing input/profile arguments instead of fixed positions shifted by Electron debugger flags.

limitations: No whatsapp-web.js dependency was installed or run; LocalAuth, browser packaging, WhatsApp IDs and ACK semantics still require controlled integration verification.
All contacts, telephone numbers, conversations and QR area are synthetic design examples.
Only Olivia is the complete interactive customer example; other customers and search rows demonstrate layout.
Protocol, authorization, source version checks and durable sending ledgers are proposed, not implemented.
